gpui_edge_geometry.phase2_defect: Single/multi-segment axis-aligned rectangular boxes painted instead of quadratic Bezier curves at >500 and >3000 nodes.
gpui_edge_geometry.phase3_fix: Implemented Lyon path builder curve_to quadratic Bezier strokes with control point M = (P+Q)/2 + perp * 0.06. Batched in chunks of 4,000 curves per PathBuilder. Passes unit tests and visual rest-frame inspection.

unified_label_contract.verification: GPUI and WebView2 render identical label subsets (+/- 0.02% rounding tolerance) across all dataset scales.

resting_frame_screenshots.method: Rendered with --scenario idle --duration 15, resting camera at (600, 400, 1.0). Captured after window stabilization without motion blur.

methodology_fixes.presentation_fps_disclaimer: Both GPUI and WebView2 present asynchronously through Windows DWM/DXGI swapchain without a hardware vblank sync callback. The previous claim of 280+ FPS was rendering cadence, not physical display presentation. Both engines now report presentation FPS as NOT_MEASURED.
methodology_fixes.memory_tree_tracking: Replaced single-PID tracking with dynamic process tree measurement via Win32_Process. Private Bytes and Working Set are separated and summed across all child processes of the executable.
methodology_fixes.process_cleanup: Terminating processes now traverses child PIDs strictly belonging to the root process ID ($p.Id). Global process kill commands for msedgewebview2 have been eradicated.
